chapter_seo_title: Chapter 433 of Dao Gui Yi Xian: The Zuowandao summon a foreign empire in a desperate gambit!
chapter_meta_description: The game board doubles as the Zuowandao reveal their true plan—importing Great Qi reinforcements via North Wind's capture. Li Huowang must navigate a celestial brawl to kidnap the body-swapping Heart-Element in this lore-packed, high-stakes chapter.
og_title: Two Tables of Mahjong: The Zuowandao’s Ultimate Gambit
og_description: North Wind was never defeated—she was the key to a foreign invasion. Great Qi’s Zuowandao join the fray in a battle that bends reality itself.
twitter_title: Mahjong Gets a Second Table in Chapter 433
twitter_description: Li Huowang is pulling a bleeding North Wind out of a celestial warzone while two empires’ supernatural enforcers duke it out. The lore drop of the century.

lore_anchors.definition: A twisted expansion of the Buddhist Eight Sufferings, here depicted as fragile threads that hold a person's identity together; exposure to incomprehensible forces can unravel them, causing irreversible personality damage.
